WITH
oauth_consent AS (
    SELECT 'OAuth Consent' AS stage, 1 AS stage_order, time, event_uid, 'f_api' AS src_table
    FROM f_api
    WHERE lower(api_operation) LIKE '%token%'
       OR lower(api_operation) LIKE '%oauth%'
       OR lower(api_operation) LIKE '%consent%'
       OR lower(api_operation) LIKE '%authorize%'
    ORDER BY time
    LIMIT 1
),
ps_exec AS (
    SELECT 'PowerShell Execution' AS stage, 2 AS stage_order, time, event_uid, 'f_process' AS src_table
    FROM f_process
    WHERE lower(image_name) LIKE '%powershell%'
       OR lower(cmd_line) LIKE '%powershell%'
    ORDER BY time
    LIMIT 1
),
c2_beacon AS (
    SELECT 'C2 Beacon' AS stage, 3 AS stage_order, time, event_uid, 'f_network' AS src_table
    FROM f_network
    WHERE dst_port IN (4444, 8080, 8443, 1337, 31337, 6667, 6666, 9001, 9050)
    ORDER BY time
    LIMIT 1
),
lateral_conn AS (
    SELECT 'Lateral Connection' AS stage, 4 AS stage_order, time, event_uid, 'f_auth' AS src_table
    FROM f_auth
    WHERE is_remote = true
    ORDER BY time
    LIMIT 1
),
no_mfa_priv AS (
    SELECT 'No-MFA Privilege Escalation' AS stage, 5 AS stage_order, time, event_uid, 'f_api' AS src_table
    FROM f_api
    WHERE mfa_present = false
      AND api_operation IN ('AttachUserPolicy','CreatePolicyVersion','PutUserPolicy',
                            'AddUserToGroup','CreateAccessKey','ListRoles')
    ORDER BY time
    LIMIT 1
),
role_assume AS (
    SELECT 'Role Assumption' AS stage, 6 AS stage_order, time, event_uid, 'f_api' AS src_table
    FROM f_api
    WHERE api_operation = 'AssumeRole'
    ORDER BY time
    LIMIT 1
),
data_exfil AS (
    SELECT 'Data Exfiltration' AS stage, 7 AS stage_order, time, event_uid, 'f_api' AS src_table
    FROM f_api
    WHERE service = 's3'
      AND api_operation IN ('GetObject','ListBucket','PutObject')
    ORDER BY time DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
combined AS (
    SELECT * FROM oauth_consent
    UNION ALL SELECT * FROM ps_exec
    UNION ALL SELECT * FROM c2_beacon
    UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lateral_conn
    UNION ALL SELECT * FROM no_mfa_priv
    UNION ALL SELECT * FROM role_assume
    UNION ALL SELECT * FROM data_exfil
)
SELECT
    row_number() OVER (ORDER BY time_ms) AS actual_order,
    stage_order                           AS defined_stage_num,
    stage,
    src_table,
    epoch_ms(time_ms)                     AS event_time,
    time_ms
FROM (
    SELECT stage, stage_order, src_table, time AS time_ms, event_uid
    FROM combined
)
ORDER BY time_ms

WITH

oauth_consent AS (
    SELECT
        'oauth_consent' AS stage,
        event_uid,
        time,
        epoch_ms(time)::TIMESTAMP AS event_time,
        api_operation || ' (' || service || ')' AS detail,
        actor_user_uid AS actor,
        CASE WHEN mfa_present = False OR mfa_value = False THEN 'no-MFA' ELSE 'MFA-ok' END AS mfa_note
    FROM f_api
    WHERE event_uid = 'api-needle-0'
),

powershell_exec AS (
    SELECT
        'powershell_execution' AS stage,
        event_uid,
        time,
        epoch_ms(time)::TIMESTAMP AS event_time,
        image_name || ' (parent: ' || parent_image_name || ')' AS detail,
        actor_user_uid AS actor,
        'N/A' AS mfa_note
    FROM f_process
    WHERE event_uid = 'proc-needle-1'
),

c2_dns AS (
    SELECT
        'c2_dns_lookup' AS stage,
        event_uid,
        time,
        epoch_ms(time)::TIMESTAMP AS event_time,
        'DNS query: ' || query_hostname || ' -> ' || answer AS detail,
        src_hostname AS actor,
        'N/A' AS mfa_note
    FROM f_dns
    WHERE event_uid = 'dns-needle-c2'
),

c2_beacon AS (
    SELECT
        'c2_beacon' AS stage,
        event_uid,
        time,
        epoch_ms(time)::TIMESTAMP AS event_time,
        src_hostname || ' -> ' || dst_ip || ':' || dst_port || ' (' || protocol_name || ')' AS detail,
        src_hostname AS actor,
        'N/A' AS mfa_note
    FROM f_network
    WHERE event_uid = 'conn-needle-beacon-00'
),

lateral_move AS (
    SELECT
        'lateral_connection' AS stage,
        event_uid,
        time,
        epoch_ms(time)::TIMESTAMP AS event_time,
        src_ip || ' -> ' || target_host || ' (is_remote=' || is_remote || ')' AS detail,
        user_uid AS actor,
        'N/A' AS mfa_note
    FROM f_auth
    WHERE event_uid = 'auth-needle-lateral'
),

priv_escalation AS (
    SELECT
        'nomfa_privilege_escalation' AS stage,
        event_uid,
        time,
        epoch_ms(time)::TIMESTAMP AS event_time,
        api_operation || ' (' || service || ')' AS detail,
        actor_user_uid AS actor,
        'mfa_present=' || CAST(mfa_present AS VARCHAR) AS mfa_note
    FROM f_api
    WHERE event_uid = 'api-needle-nomfa'
),

role_assumption AS (
    SELECT
        'role_assumption' AS stage,
        event_uid,
        time,
        epoch_ms(time)::TIMESTAMP AS event_time,
        api_operation || ' (' || service || ')' AS detail,
        actor_user_uid AS actor,
        CASE WHEN mfa_value = False THEN 'no-MFA' ELSE 'MFA-ok' END AS mfa_note
    FROM f_api
    WHERE event_uid = 'api-needle-assumerole'
),

data_exfil AS (
    SELECT
        'data_exfiltration' AS stage,
        event_uid,
        time,
        epoch_ms(time)::TIMESTAMP AS event_time,
        api_operation || ' (s3) — first of ' || (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM f_api WHERE event_uid LIKE 'api-needle-exfil-%') || ' exfil events' AS detail,
        actor_user_uid AS actor,
        CASE WHEN mfa_value = False THEN 'no-MFA-session' ELSE 'MFA-ok' END AS mfa_note
    FROM f_api
    WHERE event_uid = 'api-needle-exfil-00'
)

SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY time) AS kill_chain_step,
    stage,
    event_uid,
    event_time,
    detail,
    actor,
    mfa_note
FROM (
    SELECT * FROM oauth_consent
    UNION ALL SELECT * FROM powershell_exec
    UNION ALL SELECT * FROM c2_dns
    UNION ALL SELECT * FROM c2_beacon
    UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lateral_move
    UNION ALL SELECT * FROM priv_escalation
    UNION ALL SELECT * FROM role_assumption
    UNION ALL SELECT * FROM data_exfil
)
ORDER BY time

WITH all_stages AS (

  -- Stage 1: OAuth consent — sts:GetSessionToken without MFA (initial stolen-token entry)
  SELECT 
    1 AS stage_order,
    'OAuth consent' AS kill_chain_stage,
    MIN(time) AS first_event_time,
    to_timestamp(MIN(time)/1000) AS first_event_ts,
    MIN(event_uid) AS event_uid,
    MIN(actor_user_uid) AS actor,
    MIN(service || ':' || api_operation) AS event_detail
  FROM f_api
  WHERE event_uid ILIKE '%needle%'
    AND service = 'sts' AND api_operation = 'GetSessionToken'

  UNION ALL

  -- Stage 2: PowerShell execution — encoded command launch
  SELECT
    2,
    'PowerShell execution',
    MIN(time),
    to_timestamp(MIN(time)/1000),
    MIN(event_uid),
    MIN(actor_user_uid),
    MIN(image_name || ': ' || LEFT(COALESCE(cmd_line,''),80))
  FROM f_process
  WHERE event_uid ILIKE '%needle%'
    AND image_name ILIKE '%powershell%'

  UNION ALL

  -- Stage 3: C2 beacon — DNS query for C2 domain, followed by periodic beaconing connections
  SELECT
    3,
    'C2 beacon',
    MIN(time),
    to_timestamp(MIN(time)/1000),
    MIN(event_uid),
    MIN(src_hostname),
    MIN(query_hostname || ' -> ' || COALESCE(answer,'?'))
  FROM f_dns
  WHERE event_uid ILIKE '%needle%'

  UNION ALL

  -- Stage 4: Lateral connection — remote auth success to internal host
  SELECT
    4,
    'Lateral connection',
    MIN(time),
    to_timestamp(MIN(time)/1000),
    MIN(event_uid),
    MIN(user_uid),
    MIN('auth to ' || COALESCE(target_host,'?') || ' from ' || COALESCE(src_ip,'?') || ' [remote=' || CAST(is_remote AS VARCHAR) || ']')
  FROM f_auth
  WHERE event_uid ILIKE '%needle%'
    AND is_remote = True

  UNION ALL

  -- Stage 5: No-MFA privilege escalation — iam:AttachUserPolicy without MFA present
  SELECT
    5,
    'No-MFA privilege escalation',
    MIN(time),
    to_timestamp(MIN(time)/1000),
    MIN(event_uid),
    MIN(actor_user_uid),
    MIN(service || ':' || api_operation || ' [mfa_present=' || CAST(mfa_present AS VARCHAR) || ']')
  FROM f_api
  WHERE event_uid ILIKE '%needle%'
    AND service = 'iam' AND mfa_present = False

  UNION ALL

  -- Stage 6: Role assumption — sts:AssumeRole
  SELECT
    6,
    'Role assumption',
    MIN(time),
    to_timestamp(MIN(time)/1000),
    MIN(event_uid),
    MIN(actor_user_uid),
    MIN(service || ':' || api_operation || ' [mfa_value=' || CAST(mfa_value AS VARCHAR) || ']')
  FROM f_api
  WHERE event_uid ILIKE '%needle%'
    AND service = 'sts' AND api_operation = 'AssumeRole'

  UNION ALL

  -- Stage 7: Data exfiltration — bulk s3:GetObject from sensitive bucket via assumed role
  SELECT
    7,
    'Data exfiltration',
    MIN(time),
    to_timestamp(MIN(time)/1000),
    MIN(event_uid),
    MIN(actor_user_uid),
    MIN(service || ':' || api_operation || ' resource=' || COALESCE(resource,'?'))
  FROM f_api
  WHERE event_uid ILIKE '%needle%'
    AND service = 's3' AND api_operation = 'GetObject'
)
SELECT
  stage_order       AS "#",
  kill_chain_stage  AS stage,
  first_event_ts    AS occurred_at,
  event_uid         AS anchor_event,
  actor,
  event_detail      AS detail
FROM all_stages
ORDER BY first_event_time

WITH stage_events AS (
    -- OAuth consent: GetSessionToken is the closest proxy in this dataset (STS token issuance)
    SELECT 
        'oauth_consent' AS stage_name,
        MIN(time) AS first_time,
        MIN(event_uid) AS representative_event,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count
    FROM f_api
    WHERE api_operation = 'GetSessionToken' AND service = 'sts'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- PowerShell execution
    SELECT 
        'powershell_execution' AS stage_name,
        MIN(time) AS first_time,
        MIN(event_uid) AS representative_event,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count
    FROM f_process
    WHERE lower(image_name) LIKE '%powershell%' 
       OR lower(image_name) LIKE '%pwsh%'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- C2 beacon: outbound connections to 93.x.x.x external range
    SELECT 
        'c2_beacon' AS stage_name,
        MIN(time) AS first_time,
        MIN(event_uid) AS representative_event,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count
    FROM f_network
    WHERE dst_ip LIKE '93.%'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Lateral connection: SMB/RDP/WinRM/SSH lateral movement ports
    SELECT 
        'lateral_connection' AS stage_name,
        MIN(time) AS first_time,
        MIN(event_uid) AS representative_event,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count
    FROM f_network
    WHERE dst_port IN (3389, 445, 5985, 5986, 135, 22)
      AND src_hostname IS NOT NULL
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- No-MFA privilege escalation: privilege API operations where mfa_value = False
    SELECT 
        'no_mfa_privilege_escalation' AS stage_name,
        MIN(time) AS first_time,
        MIN(event_uid) AS representative_event,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count
    FROM f_api
    WHERE mfa_value = False
      AND api_operation IN ('CreatePolicyVersion', 'AttachUserPolicy', 'AssumeRole',
                            'ListRoles', 'GetUser', 'RunInstances', 'DescribeInstances')
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Role assumption: STS AssumeRole
    SELECT 
        'role_assumption' AS stage_name,
        MIN(time) AS first_time,
        MIN(event_uid) AS representative_event,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count
    FROM f_api
    WHERE api_operation = 'AssumeRole' AND service = 'sts'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Data exfiltration: S3 GetObject bulk reads
    SELECT 
        'data_exfiltration' AS stage_name,
        MIN(time) AS first_time,
        MIN(event_uid) AS representative_event,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count
    FROM f_api
    WHERE api_operation = 'GetObject' AND service = 's3'
)
SELECT 
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY first_time) AS kill_chain_step,
    stage_name,
    first_time AS first_event_time_ms,
    strftime(epoch_ms(first_time), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ') AS first_event_ts,
    representative_event,
    event_count AS total_events_in_stage
FROM stage_events
WHERE first_time IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY first_time

WITH kill_chain_stages AS (
    -- Stage 1: OAuth consent — GetSessionToken with mfa_value=False (initial OAuth/credential grant without full MFA)
    SELECT 1 AS stage_order, 'OAuth consent' AS stage, event_uid, time,
           service || '/' || api_operation AS detail,
           actor_user_uid AS actor
    FROM f_api
    WHERE event_uid = 'api-needle-0'

    UNION ALL

    -- Stage 2: PowerShell execution — encoded command dropper
    SELECT 2, 'PowerShell execution', event_uid, time,
           image_name AS detail,
           actor_user_uid AS actor
    FROM f_process
    WHERE event_uid = 'proc-needle-1'

    UNION ALL

    -- Stage 3: C2 beacon — DNS resolution of C2 domain followed by repeated outbound connections
    SELECT 3, 'C2 beacon', event_uid, time,
           query_hostname || ' -> ' || answer AS detail,
           NULL AS actor
    FROM f_dns
    WHERE event_uid = 'dns-needle-c2'

    UNION ALL

    -- Stage 4: Lateral connection — RDP auth + network connection to adjacent host
    SELECT 4, 'Lateral connection', event_uid, time,
           'RDP to ' || target_host AS detail,
           user_uid AS actor
    FROM f_auth
    WHERE event_uid = 'auth-needle-lateral'

    UNION ALL

    -- Stage 5: No-MFA privilege escalation — AttachUserPolicy with mfa_present=False
    SELECT 5, 'No-MFA privilege escalation', event_uid, time,
           service || '/' || api_operation AS detail,
           actor_user_uid AS actor
    FROM f_api
    WHERE event_uid = 'api-needle-nomfa'

    UNION ALL

    -- Stage 6: Role assumption — AssumeRole (AdminRole) with mfa_value=False
    SELECT 6, 'Role assumption', event_uid, time,
           service || '/' || api_operation AS detail,
           actor_user_uid AS actor
    FROM f_api
    WHERE event_uid = 'api-needle-assumerole'

    UNION ALL

    -- Stage 7: Data exfiltration — S3 GetObject on financials bucket under assumed AdminRole
    SELECT 7, 'Data exfiltration', event_uid, time,
           service || '/' || api_operation || ' -> ' || resource AS detail,
           actor_user_uid AS actor
    FROM f_api
    WHERE event_uid = 'api-needle-exfil-00'
)
SELECT stage_order,
       stage,
       event_uid,
       strftime(epoch_ms(time), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') AS event_time,
       detail,
       actor
FROM kill_chain_stages
ORDER BY stage_order

WITH stages AS (
    -- Stage: OAuth Consent (remote authentication event - unique is_remote=TRUE marker)
    SELECT
        'OAuth Consent'            AS stage,
        'f_auth'                   AS source_table,
        'is_remote=TRUE auth'      AS signal,
        MIN(time)                  AS first_event_ms,
        to_timestamp(MIN(time)/1000) AS first_event_utc
    FROM f_auth
    WHERE is_remote = TRUE AND outcome = 'SUCCESS'

    UNION ALL

    -- Stage: PowerShell Execution
    SELECT
        'PowerShell Execution'     AS stage,
        'f_process'                AS source_table,
        'image_name=powershell.exe' AS signal,
        MIN(time)                  AS first_event_ms,
        to_timestamp(MIN(time)/1000) AS first_event_utc
    FROM f_process
    WHERE lower(image_name) LIKE '%powershell%'

    UNION ALL

    -- Stage: C2 Beacon (outbound port 8080, non-standard beacon port)
    SELECT
        'C2 Beacon'                AS stage,
        'f_network'                AS source_table,
        'dst_port=8080 outbound'   AS signal,
        MIN(time)                  AS first_event_ms,
        to_timestamp(MIN(time)/1000) AS first_event_utc
    FROM f_network
    WHERE dst_port = 8080

    UNION ALL

    -- Stage: Lateral Connection (SMB/RDP/SSH between hosts)
    SELECT
        'Lateral Connection'       AS stage,
        'f_network'                AS source_table,
        'dst_port IN (22,445,3389)' AS signal,
        MIN(time)                  AS first_event_ms,
        to_timestamp(MIN(time)/1000) AS first_event_utc
    FROM f_network
    WHERE dst_port IN (22, 445, 3389)

    UNION ALL

    -- Stage: No-MFA Privilege Escalation (IAM policy mutation without MFA)
    SELECT
        'No-MFA Privilege Escalation' AS stage,
        'f_api'                       AS source_table,
        'IAM CreatePolicyVersion/AttachUserPolicy mfa_value=FALSE' AS signal,
        MIN(time)                     AS first_event_ms,
        to_timestamp(MIN(time)/1000)  AS first_event_utc
    FROM f_api
    WHERE service = 'iam'
      AND api_operation IN ('CreatePolicyVersion', 'AttachUserPolicy')
      AND mfa_value = FALSE

    UNION ALL

    -- Stage: Role Assumption (AssumeRole)
    SELECT
        'Role Assumption'          AS stage,
        'f_api'                    AS source_table,
        'AssumeRole via STS'       AS signal,
        MIN(time)                  AS first_event_ms,
        to_timestamp(MIN(time)/1000) AS first_event_utc
    FROM f_api
    WHERE api_operation = 'AssumeRole'

    UNION ALL

    -- Stage: Data Exfiltration (S3 GetObject / PutObject reads out data)
    SELECT
        'Data Exfiltration'        AS stage,
        'f_api'                    AS source_table,
        's3 GetObject or PutObject' AS signal,
        MIN(time)                  AS first_event_ms,
        to_timestamp(MIN(time)/1000) AS first_event_utc
    FROM f_api
    WHERE service = 's3'
      AND api_operation IN ('GetObject', 'PutObject')
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY first_event_ms) AS kill_chain_order,
    stage,
    source_table,
    signal,
    first_event_ms,
    first_event_utc
FROM stages
ORDER BY first_event_ms

WITH stage1 AS (
    SELECT 1 AS stage_order, 'OAuth consent' AS stage_name, time,
           'f_api' AS source_table,
           service || ':' || api_operation || ' by jdoe from external IP (no MFA)' AS description,
           actor_user_uid AS actor
    FROM f_api
    WHERE service = 'sts' AND api_operation = 'GetSessionToken'
      AND actor_user_uid = 'arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/jdoe'
      AND mfa_value = False
      AND src_ip = '203.0.113.7'
    ORDER BY time LIMIT 1
),
stage2 AS (
    SELECT 2, 'PowerShell execution', time, 'f_process',
           parent_image_name || ' -> ' || image_name || ' EncodedCommand (IEX dropper)',
           actor_user_uid
    FROM f_process
    WHERE cmd_line LIKE '%EncodedCommand%'
    LIMIT 1
),
stage3 AS (
    SELECT 3, 'C2 beacon', time, 'f_network',
           src_hostname || ' -> ' || dst_ip || ':' || dst_port::VARCHAR || ' (HTTPS C2 channel)',
           src_hostname
    FROM f_network
    WHERE src_hostname = 'WS1' AND dst_ip = '203.0.113.66'
    ORDER BY time LIMIT 1
),
stage4 AS (
    SELECT 4, 'Lateral connection', time, 'f_network',
           src_hostname || ' -> ' || dst_ip || ':' || dst_port::VARCHAR || ' (RDP lateral move to WS2)',
           src_hostname
    FROM f_network
    WHERE src_hostname = 'WS1' AND dst_ip = '10.10.1.22' AND dst_port = 3389
    ORDER BY time LIMIT 1
),
stage5 AS (
    SELECT 5, 'No-MFA privilege escalation', time, 'f_api',
           service || ':' || api_operation || ' (mfa_value=False) — privilege grant without MFA',
           actor_user_uid
    FROM f_api
    WHERE service = 'iam' AND api_operation = 'AttachUserPolicy'
      AND mfa_value = False AND time > 1767866700000
    ORDER BY time LIMIT 1
),
stage6 AS (
    SELECT 6, 'Role assumption', time, 'f_api',
           service || ':' || api_operation || ' -> AdminRole/jdoe-session (no MFA)',
           actor_user_uid
    FROM f_api
    WHERE service = 'sts' AND api_operation = 'AssumeRole'
      AND actor_user_uid LIKE '%AdminRole%' AND mfa_value = False
    ORDER BY time LIMIT 1
),
stage7 AS (
    SELECT 7, 'Data exfiltration', time, 'f_api',
           service || ':' || api_operation || ' <- ' || resource || ' (bulk financial data pull)',
           actor_user_uid
    FROM f_api
    WHERE service = 's3' AND api_operation = 'GetObject'
      AND actor_user_uid LIKE '%AdminRole%'
    ORDER BY time LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    stage_order,
    stage_name,
    time AS epoch_ms,
    strftime(epoch_ms(time), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC') AS event_time,
    source_table,
    description,
    actor
FROM (
    SELECT * FROM stage1
    UNION ALL SELECT * FROM stage2
    UNION ALL SELECT * FROM stage3
    UNION ALL SELECT * FROM stage4
    UNION ALL SELECT * FROM stage5
    UNION ALL SELECT * FROM stage6
    UNION ALL SELECT * FROM stage7
)
ORDER BY stage_order

WITH kill_chain AS (
    -- Stage 1: OAuth consent / initial credential grant (GetSessionToken with no MFA verification on token)
    SELECT
        1 AS stage_order,
        'OAuth consent / credential grant' AS stage_name,
        event_uid,
        time,
        strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', epoch_ms(time)) AS event_time,
        'f_api' AS source_table,
        api_operation || ' (' || service || ') actor=' || actor_user_uid AS description
    FROM f_api
    WHERE event_uid = 'api-needle-0'

    UNION ALL

    -- Stage 2: PowerShell execution (encoded command = initial execution)
    SELECT
        2,
        'PowerShell execution',
        event_uid,
        time,
        strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', epoch_ms(time)),
        'f_process',
        image_name || ' on ' || device_hostname || ' user=' || actor_user_uid
    FROM f_process
    WHERE event_uid = 'proc-needle-1'

    UNION ALL

    -- Stage 3: C2 beacon (first beacon after DNS resolution)
    SELECT
        3,
        'C2 beacon (first)',
        event_uid,
        time,
        strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', epoch_ms(time)),
        'f_network',
        src_ip || ' -> ' || dst_ip || ':' || CAST(dst_port AS VARCHAR) || ' (' || protocol_name || ')'
    FROM f_network
    WHERE event_uid = 'conn-needle-beacon-00'

    UNION ALL

    -- Stage 4: Lateral connection (remote auth success to another host)
    SELECT
        4,
        'Lateral connection (no-MFA remote auth)',
        event_uid,
        time,
        strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', epoch_ms(time)),
        'f_auth',
        user_uid || ' src=' || src_ip || ' -> ' || target_host || ' outcome=' || outcome
    FROM f_auth
    WHERE event_uid = 'auth-needle-lateral'

    UNION ALL

    -- Stage 5: No-MFA privilege escalation (AttachUserPolicy with mfa_present=False)
    SELECT
        5,
        'No-MFA privilege escalation',
        event_uid,
        time,
        strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', epoch_ms(time)),
        'f_api',
        api_operation || ' (' || service || ') mfa_present=' || CAST(mfa_present AS VARCHAR) || ' actor=' || actor_user_uid
    FROM f_api
    WHERE event_uid = 'api-needle-nomfa'

    UNION ALL

    -- Stage 6: Role assumption (AssumeRole)
    SELECT
        6,
        'Role assumption (AssumeRole)',
        event_uid,
        time,
        strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', epoch_ms(time)),
        'f_api',
        api_operation || ' (' || service || ') actor=' || actor_user_uid
    FROM f_api
    WHERE event_uid = 'api-needle-assumerole'

    UNION ALL

    -- Stage 7: Data exfiltration (first GetObject from S3 financials bucket)
    SELECT
        7,
        'Data exfiltration (S3 GetObject)',
        event_uid,
        time,
        strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', epoch_ms(time)),
        'f_api',
        api_operation || ' (' || service || ') resource=' || resource || ' actor=' || actor_user_uid
    FROM f_api
    WHERE event_uid = 'api-needle-exfil-00'
)
SELECT
    stage_order,
    stage_name,
    event_uid,
    event_time,
    source_table,
    description
FROM kill_chain
ORDER BY stage_order

WITH all_events AS (
    SELECT time FROM f_auth
    UNION ALL
    SELECT time FROM f_session
    UNION ALL
    SELECT time FROM f_network
    UNION ALL
    SELECT time FROM f_dns
    UNION ALL
    SELECT time FROM f_process
    UNION ALL
    SELECT time FROM f_api
)
SELECT 
    (MAX(time) - MIN(time)) / 1000 AS dwell_seconds
FROM all_events

WITH jdoe_direct_hosts AS (
    SELECT target_host AS ref FROM f_auth WHERE user_uid = 'jdoe@acme.example' AND target_host IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT host FROM f_session WHERE user_uid = 'jdoe@acme.example' AND host IS NOT NULL
),
jdoe_direct_ips AS (
    SELECT src_ip AS ref FROM f_auth WHERE user_uid = 'jdoe@acme.example' AND src_ip IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT src_ip FROM f_api WHERE actor_user_uid LIKE '%jdoe%' AND src_ip IS NOT NULL
),
matched_assets AS (
    SELECT fa.ip
    FROM f_asset fa
    WHERE fa.hostname IN (SELECT ref FROM jdoe_direct_hosts)
    UNION
    SELECT fa.ip
    FROM f_asset fa
    WHERE fa.ip IN (SELECT ref FROM jdoe_direct_ips)
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ip) AS distinct_physical_assets
FROM matched_assets

WITH actor_touched_hostnames AS (
    -- Hostnames from process events (actor ran code here)
    SELECT device_hostname AS hostname
    FROM f_process
    WHERE actor_user_uid = 'S-1-5-21-3623811015-3361044348-30300820-1107'
    UNION
    -- Hostnames from auth events (actor authenticated to these)
    SELECT target_host
    FROM f_auth
    WHERE user_uid = 'jdoe@acme.example'
      AND target_host IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    -- Hostnames from session events
    SELECT host
    FROM f_session
    WHERE user_uid = 'jdoe@acme.example'
      AND host IS NOT NULL
),
-- Map to f_asset rows for alias closure
actor_direct_assets AS (
    SELECT a.hostname, a.ip, a.instance_uid
    FROM f_asset a
    WHERE a.hostname IN (SELECT hostname FROM actor_touched_hostnames)
),
-- Expand via shared IP (alias collapse: hosts sharing an IP = same physical machine)
all_aliases AS (
    SELECT a.ip
    FROM f_asset a
    WHERE a.hostname IN (SELECT hostname FROM actor_direct_assets)
       OR a.ip IN (SELECT ip FROM actor_direct_assets)
)
-- Count distinct physical assets = distinct IPs after closure
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ip) AS distinct_physical_assets
FROM all_aliases

WITH jdoe_uids AS (
    SELECT id FROM (VALUES 
        ('jdoe@acme.example'),
        ('arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/jdoe'),
        ('arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/AdminRole/jdoe-session'),
        ('S-1-5-21-3623811015-3361044348-30300820-1107')
    ) t(id)
),
jdoe_raw_refs AS (
    SELECT target_host AS ref, 'hostname' AS kind 
    FROM f_auth WHERE user_uid IN (SELECT id FROM jdoe_uids) AND target_host IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT src_ip, 'ip' 
    FROM f_auth WHERE user_uid IN (SELECT id FROM jdoe_uids) AND src_ip IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT host, 'hostname' 
    FROM f_session WHERE user_uid IN (SELECT id FROM jdoe_uids)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT device_hostname, 'hostname' 
    FROM f_process WHERE actor_user_uid IN (SELECT id FROM jdoe_uids)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT src_ip, 'ip' 
    FROM f_api WHERE actor_user_uid IN (SELECT id FROM jdoe_uids) AND src_ip IS NOT NULL
),
matched_canonical AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.canonical_asset
    FROM f_asset a
    JOIN jdoe_raw_refs r ON 
        (r.kind = 'hostname' AND a.hostname = r.ref)
        OR (r.kind = 'ip' AND a.ip = r.ref)
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT canonical_asset) AS distinct_physical_assets
FROM matched_canonical

WITH jdoe_asset_hostnames AS (
    SELECT target_host AS hn
    FROM f_auth
    WHERE user_uid LIKE '%jdoe%' AND target_host IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT host
    FROM f_session
    WHERE user_uid LIKE '%jdoe%' AND host IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT src_hostname
    FROM f_network
    WHERE src_ip IN (SELECT DISTINCT src_ip FROM f_auth WHERE user_uid LIKE '%jdoe%')
      AND src_hostname IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT src_hostname
    FROM f_dns
    WHERE src_ip IN (SELECT DISTINCT src_ip FROM f_auth WHERE user_uid LIKE '%jdoe%')
      AND src_hostname IS NOT NULL
),
asset_rows AS (
    SELECT a.hostname, a.ip, a.instance_uid
    FROM f_asset a
    WHERE a.hostname IN (SELECT hn FROM jdoe_asset_hostnames)
),
expanded AS (
    SELECT a.hostname, a.ip, a.instance_uid
    FROM f_asset a
    WHERE a.ip IN (SELECT ip FROM asset_rows)
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ip) AS distinct_physical_assets
FROM expanded

WITH jdoe_asset_refs AS (
    -- From f_session (jdoe@acme.example -> WS1)
    SELECT a.canonical_asset FROM f_session s JOIN f_asset a ON s.host = a.hostname WHERE s.user_uid = 'jdoe@acme.example'
    UNION
    -- From f_auth target_host (jdoe@acme.example -> WS2)
    SELECT a.canonical_asset FROM f_auth au JOIN f_asset a ON au.target_host = a.hostname WHERE au.user_uid = 'jdoe@acme.example'
    UNION
    -- From f_process device (Windows SID -1107 on WS1)
    SELECT a.canonical_asset FROM f_process p JOIN f_asset a ON p.device_hostname = a.hostname
    WHERE p.actor_user_uid = 'S-1-5-21-3623811015-3361044348-30300820-1107'
    UNION
    -- From f_auth src_ip (10.10.1.21 -> match in f_asset by ip)
    SELECT a.canonical_asset FROM f_auth au JOIN f_asset a ON au.src_ip = a.ip WHERE au.user_uid = 'jdoe@acme.example'
    UNION
    -- From f_api src_ip (203.0.113.7 -> match in f_asset by ip)
    SELECT a.canonical_asset FROM f_api api JOIN f_asset a ON api.src_ip = a.ip WHERE api.actor_user_uid LIKE '%jdoe%'
),
-- Collapse alias groups: two f_asset rows sharing ip OR instance_uid are the same physical asset
alias_groups AS (
    SELECT a1.canonical_asset AS asset,
           MIN(a2.canonical_asset) AS group_leader
    FROM f_asset a1
    JOIN f_asset a2 ON (a1.ip = a2.ip OR a1.instance_uid = a2.instance_uid)
    GROUP BY a1.canonical_asset
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ag.group_leader) AS distinct_physical_assets
FROM jdoe_asset_refs jar
JOIN alias_groups ag ON jar.canonical_asset = ag.asset

WITH jdoe_identifiers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT target_host AS ref_value, 'hostname' AS ref_type
    FROM f_auth WHERE user_uid = 'jdoe@acme.example' AND target_host IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT host, 'hostname'
    FROM f_session WHERE user_uid = 'jdoe@acme.example' AND host IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT device_hostname, 'hostname'
    FROM f_process WHERE actor_user_uid = 'S-1-5-21-3623811015-3361044348-30300820-1107' AND device_hostname IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT src_ip, 'ip'
    FROM f_auth WHERE user_uid = 'jdoe@acme.example' AND src_ip IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT src_ip, 'ip'
    FROM f_api WHERE actor_user_uid LIKE '%jdoe%' AND src_ip IS NOT NULL
),
canonical_assets AS (
    SELECT fa.canonical_asset
    FROM jdoe_identifiers ji
    JOIN f_asset fa ON ji.ref_type = 'hostname' AND ji.ref_value = fa.hostname
    UNION
    SELECT fa.canonical_asset
    FROM jdoe_identifiers ji
    JOIN f_asset fa ON ji.ref_type = 'ip' AND ji.ref_value = fa.ip
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT canonical_asset) AS distinct_physical_assets
FROM canonical_assets

WITH jdoe_events AS (
  -- Gather all asset references for jdoe across all event tables
  SELECT target_host as asset_ref FROM f_auth WHERE user_uid = 'jdoe@acme.example'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT host FROM f_session WHERE user_uid = 'jdoe@acme.example'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT device_hostname FROM f_process WHERE actor_user_uid = 'S-1-5-21-3623811015-3361044348-30300820-1107'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT resource FROM f_api WHERE actor_user_uid = 'arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/jdoe'
),
jdoe_named_assets AS (
  -- Filter to non-null asset references and join to f_asset to get IP for collapsing
  SELECT DISTINCT a.ip as collapse_key
  FROM jdoe_events e
  JOIN f_asset a ON e.asset_ref = a.hostname OR e.asset_ref = a.ip OR e.asset_ref = a.instance_uid
  WHERE e.asset_ref IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT collapse_key) as distinct_physical_assets
FROM jdoe_named_assets

WITH jdoe_hosts AS (
    SELECT target_host AS hostname FROM f_auth WHERE user_uid LIKE '%jdoe%'
    UNION
    SELECT host FROM f_session WHERE user_uid LIKE '%jdoe%'
    UNION
    SELECT device_hostname FROM f_process
    WHERE actor_user_uid = 'S-1-5-21-3623811015-3361044348-30300820-1107'
),
jdoe_assets AS (
    SELECT fa.hostname, fa.ip, fa.instance_uid
    FROM f_asset fa
    INNER JOIN jdoe_hosts jh ON fa.hostname = jh.hostname
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ip) AS distinct_physical_assets
FROM jdoe_assets
